description: Upload the product file buyers receive (zip, pdf, epub, docx, xlsx, pptx, txt, md, csv, json, png, jpg, webp, gif, mp3, wav or mp4), sent as base64, max 25 MB. Returns file_id; pass it to create_listing or update_listing. The file stays private and is only delivered to paying buyers (free listings link to it directly). For bigger products use a download link instead. Max 20 uploads per hour. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

data.description: The whole file encoded as base64. Max 25 MB before encoding.

filename.description: File name buyers will see, with one of the allowed extensions, e.g. "prompt-pack.zip"

name: upload_file
title: Upload your product file
